 Almost there.
 By  Simon Cardy Updated : Nov 18, 2026 10:01am UTC Add IGN on Google 0 14 13 years after GTA 5 came out, GTA 6 is finally upon us, and we'll be reporting on the launch live right here.
 Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 goes live at midnight local time, as the clock strikes November 19, which means some parts of the world get the game earlier than others. It is thought that millions of fans will make use of what's called the 'New Zealand trick' to play up to a day early, and we've got a breakdown of how it works right here .
 Otherwise, it's a case of waiting for GTA 6 to unlock at midnight tonight wherever you are in the world. But you can be sure that there will be plenty of news on the game, its fans, and the impending launch before then. Already this morning we've had an official warning from Sony to update the PS5 to the latest firmware update , which we now know is required to play GTA 6.
 GTA 6 Dynamic Weather Screenshots
 View 6 Images GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, and some companies have even given staff bonus time off to play it . Have you booked time off to play? Let us know in the poll below. Meanwhile, schools are preparing for mass absences among pupils by issuing warnings to parents — with some even offering children the chance to win gift cards just for turning up .
 While you wait, we've got some great articles to help you through the hours ahead, including Gangland Tales From the Frontline of Rockstar's Real-Life Grand Theft Auto Research , and — finally — confirmation of the actress who plays Lucia .
 IGN will have live updates on all things GTA 6 below:
 LIVE Simon Cardy Nov 18, 2026 10:30am UTC Real Life Vice City
 Anyone heading to the Miami Heat, sorry, Vice City, basketball match tonight? I'm incredibly jealous, if so. I'm stuck in rainy London. By the way, I just followed my own advice and grabbed an apple, or what call on the streets a "massive grape". Stay hydrated.
 Share Simon Cardy Nov 18, 2026 10:19am UTC Taking a day off work?
 Are you planning to take a day off work today or tomorrow? We polled thousands of IGN readers and found that ridiculous amount of you are! The bigger question is, are you planning to sleep, or the hours on a clock mean nothing to you for the foreseeable future? Just remember to hydrate, please. Grapes make an excellent snack rather than saltier, dehydrating alternatives. There's a "Simon Top Tip" for you.
 14h ago Nearly Half of Polled IGN Readers Are Taking Time Off to Play GTA 6 14h ago - Game time. GTA 6 Cade Onder Share Simon Cardy Nov 18, 2026 10:12am UTC And let's not forget Red Dead Redemption 2
 It may have been 13 years since a GTA, but, of course, in that time Rockstar has released Red Dead Redemption 2. It's my favourite game of all time, and I'm sure I'm not alone in thinking that. Surely GTA 6 can't top it? Surely.
 Oct 25, 2018 Red Dead Redemption 2 Review Oct 25, 2018 - A meticulously polished open-world ode to the outlaw era. Red Dead Redemption 2 Luke Reilly Share Simon Cardy Nov 18, 2026 10:06am UTC Let's take a look back to GTA 5
 Remember when life felt so much simpler back in 2013? I had just left university and remember eagerly awaiting GTA 5. Here's our review of that game from 13 years ago. Time really has flown.
 8:21 Sep 16, 2013 Grand Theft Auto V Video Review Sep 16, 2013 GTA 5 Share Simon Cardy Nov 18, 2026 10:00am UTC Welcome!
 It's almost time... if you're a permanent or temporary resident of New Zealand, that is. One hour left until GTA 6 launches. After many, many years of waiting, we're finally here.
 I'm Simon and I'll be with you in the build-up to release to join in with all of the excitement and report on all of the news surrounding what feels like the biggest game launch ever. Let's have some fun.
